samples.question: A gray vertical line marks a reference column on a light panel. Two thick diagonal strokes, one red and one blue, are drawn on either side of it. Slip each stroke straight along its own tilt until its line meets the gray line; the height of that meeting is the stroke's reach. Which colored stroke's best-fit line reaches HIGHER on the panel (closer to the top) at the gray reference line? Answer with only the color: red or blue.
